root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DeliveryRouteTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.DeliveryRouteTbl', N'StopKey') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys.index_columns ic INNER JOIN sys.key_constraints kc ON kc.parent_object_id = ic.object_id AND kc.unique_index_id = ic.index_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id WHERE kc.parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DeliveryRouteTbl') AND kc.type = 'PK' AND c.name = N'StopKey') BEGIN DECLARE @pk sysname; SELECT @pk = kc.name FROM sys.key_constraints kc WHERE kc.parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DeliveryRouteTbl') AND kc.type = 'PK'; IF @pk IS NOT NULL EXEC(N'ALTER TABLE dbo.DeliveryRouteTbl DROP CONSTRAINT ' + QUOTENAME(@pk)); ALTER TABLE dbo.DeliveryRouteTbl ADD CONSTRAINT PK_DeliveryRouteTbl PRIMARY KEY (RouteDate, PersonID, ContactID, StopKey); END
